title: document/document-upload-valid-commercial-invoice.spec.ts:45 › Valid commercial invoice attachment upload › CHED-P › B2C notifier uploads a valid DOCX commercial invoice attachment
outcome: A CHED-P (products of animal origin) pre-notification is created end-to-end — import type, origin country, conformance, commodity code/species, reason, risk category, then via the Notification Hub the commodity weights/packages, temperature, a Latest Health Certificate with a DOCX attachment upload and an Accompanying documents entry with a second DOCX attachment — ending on a Success confirmation.
